copy_policy: Every selected source is copied byte-for-byte. No normalization or redaction inside evidence files.
privacy_policy: No scene photos, previews, thumbnails, partial image payloads, raw JS sample streams, or broad OS/device inventory dumps. Device-specific identifiers and original paths in exact operation logs remain as recorded.
exclusions: All PNG/BMP/full or partial photo bytes, including display previews and thumbnails
Native JS current/voltage/power/GPI/range sample files and bulk chunks.jsonl
capture-control07-record: first observation ended before reset
Broad OS process/device inventories and unrelated research downloads
Duplicate ram08-audit compiled/source tree; compact independent report and test logs retained
limitations: This index binds files and source locations; it does not broaden each record's qualification claims.
Original image comparison reports refer to local-only image/RAW evidence intentionally excluded from the public archive.
Absolute paths inside frozen manifests retain the original workspace; do not rewrite their exact bytes.
The README is owned separately by the parent and was not written by this archiving step.
